_comment: Template for tools/configure_boards.py. Copy to tools/bench_config.json,
which is GITIGNORED because it holds a Wi-Fi password and player names.
Every key except pin is optional; a key left out is a setting left alone.
wifi may be {"ssid": ..., "password": ...} or the string "clear".
theme is any name the Settings screen shows: Dark, Light, Midnight, Dusk,
Paper, Contrast, Classic, Silver, Pocket. brightness is 25..100.
